name: Metro Brands Ltd
title: Metro Brands Ltd - 543426 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone growth 20%, PAT +18%, 1,032 stores after net 42 adds; management kept FY27 growth framing at ~15% but gave no numeric guidance, and cited ~10% input-cost inflation with six months of inventory cover.

triggers.label: Input costs up ~10%, no price hikes
triggers.quote: we have seen overall input costs of 10%, maybe, so it's not significant in spike

triggers.label: Front-loaded inventory, six months cover
triggers.quote: some front loading of inventory that we did in anticipation of this price rise

triggers.label: Rental competition stabilised, not eased
triggers.quote: But I think what we are not seeing is it's acceleration that we saw.

triggers.label: Q4 SSG-led growth, footfall rising
triggers.quote: It is definitely the SSG that drives it.

guidance.value: 12% to 15% of business in near term
guidance.quote: it's going to represent somewhere between 12% to 15% of our business in the near term
we can continue to grow our business in that (+15%) range year on year

guidance.value: up to ~50 stores across Fila, Foot Locker, Clarks, MetroActiv (opportunity, not commitment)

prior_guidance_check.quote: delivered metrics in our guidance range, which has been PAT in the mid-teen percentage range
EBITDA in the high 20s to low 30s

red_flags.label: Foot Locker expansion held back by BIS certification
red_flags.quote: we still don't have 100% comfort that BIS challenges, for whatever reason, have been mitigated

red_flags.label: FILA turnaround, old inventory cleanup
red_flags.quote: we have spent a lot of time and money cleaning up the old inventory

evasions.quote: So, for me to commit and say every single quarter will be at 15% is a little bit erratic on my part.
Will we get the right locations? Will we get the right rentals?
I would never feel that the pilot is done
